entities.name: Game files for invited players
entities.description: Serves the built game, and nothing else, to invited players.
entities.responsibility: Checks icelander.net's sign-in and the role games:lundey before any file of the game leaves Cloudflare's static assets.
access: Only a player signed in to icelander.net who holds the role games:lundey gets a file; the role is asked again on every request.
A visitor who is not signed in is sent to the site's sign-in, and back to the address they asked for.
A signed-in player without the role gets a page saying the game is for invited players, with status 403; holding games:play or another game's role does not open it.
The role is granted at icelander.net/private/admin, outside this repository.

relatedViews.relationship: How the files are guarded and cached.
